headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 31, 2026**
article:
The Tampa Bay Rays secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker securing the save. In other action, the Chicago Cubs took down the St. Louis Cardinals 4-2, while the Minnesota Twins acquired left-handed pitcher A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in a blockbuster trade.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including New York Mets left-handed pitcher Cionel Pérez, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain. The Tampa Bay Rays also placed left-handed pitcher Shane McClanahan on the 15-day injured list with left mid-back tightness. The Chicago Cubs placed right-handed pitcher Gavin Hollowell on the 15-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation.

The Minnesota Twins made a significant trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in exchange for shortstop Bruin Agbayani and third baseman Billy Amick. The New York Mets also traded catcher Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles for right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, with Garrett Cleavinger earning the win and Bryan Baker securing the save.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals dropped a 3-4 decision to the Minnesota Twins, with Kody Clemens leading the offense with a grand slam and 4 RBIs. Noah Cameron pitched 8 strong innings for the Royals, allowing 0 earned runs and 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dropped a 1-2 decision to the Chicago White Sox, with the White Sox securing the win.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Cardinals 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 4-2 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Jacob Webb earning the win. JJ Wetherholt led the Cubs' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Mets Place Cionel Pérez on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Mets left-handed pitcher Cionel Pérez has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain, retroactive to July 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Minter Joins Twins in Blockbuster Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins acquired left-handed pitcher A.J. Minter from the New York Mets in exchange for shortstop Bruin Agbayani and third baseman Billy Amick.
